verdict.rationale: Superset is a repository-centric agent orchestration workspace, so querying generated repository documentation is a fair axis to judge. The evidence only shows cloning or adding repos, running agents in worktrees, and a docs MCP server for Superset's own documentation. Nothing shows it generating or serving queryable documentation for arbitrary public or private repositories.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query generated documentation for any public or private repository
